posts.title: We sorted the board by who can apply
posts.hook: We sorted 1,987 remote jobs by who can apply.
posts.variable: Data-story carousel (first of its kind for us)
posts.caption:
We sorted 1,987 remote jobs by who can apply.

Today's count: a handful are open to anyone, anywhere. Most name a country or a region, and that's useful, once you know where to look for it.

Swipe for the numbers, then filter by where you live. Link in bio.

#remotejobs #jobsearch #remotework #workfromhome

slides.title: {jobs:,} remote jobs. Who can apply?
slides.sub: Every job on our board, sorted by what the employer says.

slides.title: Open to anyone, anywhere
slides.body: Checked against each company's own job data on the day we counted.

slides.title: Open across a region
slides.body: A whole region, like EMEA or the Americas. Check that yours is in it.

slides.title: Name one or more countries
slides.body: The most common answer by far. The country is on every card.

slides.title: Don't say
slides.body: The posting doesn't state it. Ask the employer before you spend an hour.

slides.title: Start with where you live
slides.sub: Tell the board, and it shows the jobs open to you.

posts.title: We check the job, not the employer
posts.hook: We check the job. Not the employer.
posts.caption:
We check the job. Not the employer.

Every job on our board comes from the company's own hiring page, has its real posting date, and says where you can apply from, or that the employer doesn't say. We don't audit companies and we can't promise interviews, so read each employer's rules for your country before you apply.

What we check, in full: link in bio.

posts.title: V3 message cards
posts.hook: Three messages a real employer won't send you.
posts.caption: Three messages a real employer won't send you. (b-roll only)

slides.title: “There's a small fee to start your training.”
slides.sub: Real employers don't charge you to get a job.

slides.title: “Deposit this cheque and send the rest back.”
slides.sub: The cheque bounces. Your money doesn't come back.

slides.title: “We'll do the whole interview by chat.”
slides.sub: No call. No company email. Stop there.
